theater: 中原三線戰場：隴海、平漢、津浦

battle.name: 中原大戰
battle.theater: 中原三線戰場：隴海、平漢、津浦
battle.brief: 一九三〇年五月至十一月，閻錫山、馮玉祥聯軍與蔣介石中央軍在豫、魯、冀三省的隴海、平漢、津浦三條鐵路對抗，是南京政府成立後規模最大的內戰。卡面的雷諾FT輕坦克是當時中國極少數的現代化裝甲車，僅零星裝備或未及成軍，戰局仍由鐵路樞紐、砲兵與空軍決定。

kit.name: 雷諾FT輕坦克
kit.history: 雷諾FT輕坦克是第一款採用旋轉炮塔與履帶底盤的輕型坦克，1917年法國研製後廣泛用於一戰，並在1930年代被中國軍閥引進，成為當時重要的機械化裝備。

countries: 中原大戰的交戰雙方，是南京國民政府與反對南京的軍閥聯軍。南京一方以蔣介石為最高指揮：國民政府主席兼軍事委員會委員長蔣介石坐鎮徐州與鄭州前線，中央軍主力是按德式整訓的「德械師」，每師以步兵團為骨幹，附設迫擊砲連、七五或八十八毫米野砲連、輕機槍連與通信勤務，編制精幹、機動迅速，由蔣鼎文、劉峙等將領分率，沿津浦、平漢、隴海三條鐵路展開攻勢；蔣同時倚重地方軍力，韓復榘率領的山東部隊、劉鎮華在陝西的省軍與河南各縣的武裝都被編入作戰序列，並以空軍偵察、轟炸與鐵路運輸配合地面行動，還在幕後對聯軍各部施行招撫與分化。另一方是閻錫山率領的晉軍與馮玉祥率領的西北軍（國民軍）組成的聯軍：北方戰場以閻錫山為主、馮玉祥為輔，聯軍總部設在鄭州，企圖控制隴海鐵路中段，並在豫東平原與中央軍對峙；陝西方面由楊虎城、張鳳翽的十七路軍扼守潼關與西安，與中央軍在潼關一線先後交火；廣西方面則由李宗仁、白崇禧、黃紹竑率桂軍在湖南、湖北方向策應，與中央軍在湘鄂一帶較量，這一段被稱為蔣桂戰爭的最後一輪。此外，奉系的張學良與東北軍在整場戰爭中保持觀望，直到十一月才入關，使形勢決定性地倒向南京。各派將領多數出自同一批北洋與國民革命軍將校，編制裝備同源，彼此之間既有十數年共同作戰的淵源，也有長期積下的猜忌，指揮與協同的困難自始存在。
countriesEn: The two sides in the Central Plains War were the Nanjing National Government and a coalition of warlords opposed to Nanjing. On the Nanjing side the supreme commander was Chiang Kai-shek: as chairman of the National Government and of the Military Affairs Commission he sat at the front in Xuzhou and Zhengzhou, and the core of his Central Army was the German-trained division, in which the infantry regiment formed the skeleton and every division carried a mortar company, a battery of 75 mm or 88 mm field guns, a light machine-gun company and a signals section — tight in organisation and quick on the road. These units were led forward along the Tianjin-Pukou, Peking-Hankou and Longhai lines by commanders such as Chiang Ting-wen and Liu Zhi. Chiang also leaned heavily on local military power: Han Fuju's army in Shandong, Liu Zhenhua's provincial troops in Shaanxi and the armed bands of the counties of Henan were all drawn into his order of battle, while air reconnaissance, bombing and rail transport supported the ground effort, and behind the lines he worked to split the coalition by offering rank and inducement to its commanders. The other side was the alliance of Yan Xishan's Shanxi army with Feng Yuxiang's northwestern (National) army: in the northern theatre Yan was nominally in the lead and Feng second, the coalition headquarters sat at Zhengzhou, and the aim was to hold the middle section of the Longhai railway and stand against the Central Army on the eastern Henan plain. In Shaanxi the Seventeenth Route Army of Yang Hucheng and Zhang Fengxi guarded Tongguan and Xi'an and clashed with the Central Army along that front. In the south the Guangxi troops of Li Zongren, Bai Chongxi and Huang Shaoqiong drove towards Hunan and Hubei to support the coalition and fought the Central Army in the Hunan-Hubei area, a contest remembered as the last round of the Chiang-Gui war. The Fengtian clique under Zhang Xueliang and the Northeastern Army watched from the sidelines for the whole of the war and only entered the passes in November, which tipped the balance decisively towards Nanjing. Most of the commanders on both sides came out of the same pool of Beiyang and National Revolutionary Army officers, so their formations and equipment were of common origin; between them lay both the shared experience of a decade of fighting side by side and long-simmering suspicion, and the difficulty of command and coordination was present from the first day.
people: 關鍵人物橫跨三條戰線。南京方面，蔣介石是全戰役唯一自始自終握有最高指揮權的人，他推動「統一編制」與對閻、馮的整肅，把戰爭定位為國民政府成立後不得不打的統一之戰，並親赴徐州、鄭州一線調度兵員與火車；中央軍的實際作戰由蔣鼎文的第二師等部擔任，參謀長徐庭瑤策劃濟南攻城作戰，劉峙負責河南與隴海線的正面攻防，劉鎮華在陝西、寧夏方向牽制馮部，韓復榘在關鍵時刻倒戈南京、出任山東省主席，為中央軍打開津浦線的側翼。聯軍方面，閻錫山以山西省主席兼晉軍總指揮的身分主持北方戰場，起初欲觀望，嗣後因中央軍逼近太原與渭北而通電倒戈；馮玉祥任國民革命軍總司令兼西北軍總指揮，是聯軍的實際發動者，屢次主張集中兵力直取南京，卻屢遭閻方抵制；十七路軍的楊虎城在潼關一線主動出擊，打破僵局；張自忠、宋哲元等西北軍將領分別率部在隴海線與豫南作戰。南線與中央方面，李宗仁、白崇禧率桂軍北上湖南，卻被何應欽、張發奎、薛岳等部擊退，退回廣西；北方，張學良的東北軍入關，成為壓垮聯軍的最後一著。事後蔣迫閻錫山下野，閻自太原出國考察，馮玉祥則退居泰山、隱居不再出山，一九三五年被押解南京。
peopleEn: The decisive figures stretch across three fronts. On the Nanjing side Chiang Kai-shek was the only man who held supreme command from beginning to end. He drove the unification of formations and the purge of Yan and Feng, defined the war as a unification war the National Government could not avoid once founded, and went in person to Xuzhou and Zhengzhou to direct the movement of troops and trains. The actual fighting was done by the Second Division under Chiang Ting-wen and similar units; Xu Ting-yao, the chief of staff, planned the assault on Jinan; Liu Zhi held the front of the Longhai line and of Henan; Liu Zhenhua tied down Feng's forces in Shaanxi and Ningxia; and Han Fuju, who turned to Nanjing at the decisive moment and was made chairman of Shandong, opened the flank on the Tianjin-Pukou line. On the coalition side Yan Xishan, chairman of Shanxi and commander of the Shanxi army, ran the northern theatre: he wanted at first to wait and see, and only when the Central Army closed on Taiyuan and northern Shaanxi did he cable his opposition to Nanjing. Feng Yuxiang, commander in chief of the National Revolutionary Army and of the northwestern army, was the real initiator of the war, insisting again and again on concentrating forces for a march on Nanjing and being checked each time by Yan's refusal to cooperate. Yang Hucheng of the Seventeenth Route Army struck at Tongguan and broke the stalemate, and such commanders as Zhang Zizhong and Song Zheyuan led the northwestern formations on the Longhai line and in southern Henan. In the southern theatre Li Zongren and Bai Chongxi took the Guangxi army north into Hunan but were driven back by the troops of He Yingqin, Zhang Fakui and Xue Yue and withdrew into Guangxi; in the north the entry of Zhang Xueliang's Northeastern Army was the last weight that crushed the coalition. Afterwards Chiang forced Yan Xishan to resign; Yan left Taiyuan on foreign travel, and Feng Yuxiang retired to Mount Tai and withdrew from public life, to be taken to Nanjing under guard in 1935.
kits: 卡面這輛雷諾FT輕坦克，是當時中國極少數的現代化裝甲車：法國雷諾公司一九一七年定型，車重約十三點五噸，乘員二人，車體與炮塔最厚處約三十七毫米，裝一門三十七毫米短管砲與一挺八毫米機槍，動力為輸出約三十五馬力的汽油機，公路最高時速約十三公里，越野僅約四公里，一次加滿油的行程約六十公里。它在一九二〇年代經法國與英國渠道零星流入中國，張作霖的奉系、閻錫山的晉系都曾購置或繳獲少量，太原兵工廠也曾試製仿製車，但各家的裝甲部隊規模極小，多半只能充當指揮所與後勤機關的護衛。史載有限、諸說並存：本戰役中雷諾FT是否成建制參戰、由哪一支部隊掌握、投入過多少次攻勢，現存記載互相矛盾，可信度不高；唯一可以確定的是，在一場以鐵路樞紐為核心的戰爭裡，坦克並未成為決定性力量，真正發揮火力的是野砲與迫擊砲。聯軍與中央軍的裝備以步兵輕武器為主：德械師每師配七五或八十八毫米野砲連，每團配六門八十二毫米迫擊砲的迫擊砲連，另有少量一五〇毫米榴彈砲，炮彈產量有限、補充困難；騎兵、大量馬車、轎車與人力車構成機動與補給的骨幹，火車是沿隴海、平漢、津浦三線調動兵員與彈藥的工具，裝甲列車與架在平板車上的重砲曾在沿線作戰；輕武器為中正式步槍與輕機槍、手榴彈；中央軍另有航空隊的偵察機與炸彈，聯軍的飛機數量與性能都處劣勢。
kitsEn: The Renault FT light tank on the card is one of very few modern armoured vehicles in China at the time. The type was developed by Renault in France in 1917: it weighed about 13.5 tonnes, carried a crew of two, was protected by about 37 mm of armour at its thickest, and mounted one short 37 mm gun and one 8 mm machine gun. Its power came from a petrol engine of roughly 35 hp, giving about 13 km/h on the road, no more than about 4 km/h across country, and a range of some sixty kilometres on a full tank. A few found their way into China through French and British channels in the 1920s: the Fengtian clique under Zhang Zuolin and Yan's Shanxi army each had a handful bought or captured, and the arsenal at Taiyuan even attempted a copy, but the armoured formations of all these armies remained tiny and at most served as escorts for headquarters and depots. The records are thin and the accounts conflict: whether the FT was committed to battle in this war, which formation held it and how often it went into action cannot be established with confidence. The only safe statement is that in a war fought around railway junctions the tank played no decisive part, while the real firepower lay with the field guns and the mortars. The equipment of both the coalition and the Central Army rested on the light weapons of the infantry: the German-trained divisions carried a battery of 75 mm or 88 mm field guns and a mortar company of six 82 mm mortars in every regiment, with a small number of 150 mm howitzers, and shell output was limited and resupply awkward. Cavalry, large numbers of carts, lorries, rickshaws and handcarts formed the backbone of movement and supply, while trains moved men and ammunition along the Longhai, Peking-Hankou and Tianjin-Pukou lines, and armoured trains and heavy guns mounted on flat wagons did fight along the tracks. The light weapons were the standard bolt-action rifle, the light machine gun and the hand grenade; the Central Army also had aircraft for reconnaissance and bombing, and in the air the coalition was outnumbered and technically inferior.
tactics: 聯軍的戰術核心，是依托隴海鐵路與豫東平原地帶作節節抵抗。閻錫山部在蘭封、歸德一線沿鐵路兩側挖掘塹壕、構築碉堡與機槍巢，把每個縣城、車站與渡口變成阻擊點，中央軍每推進一步都要付出逐點攻克的代價；馮玉祥的西北軍則企圖以騎兵與步兵在豫陝、豫鄂邊界實施機動，尋求側翼與中央軍的薄弱之處，尤其威脅蔣在隴海線後方的交通與糧源；聯軍總部設在鄭州，意圖在中央軍兵員尚未集結時先取開封、蘭封，再以南北呼應的攻勢迫使蔣分兵。南京方面的戰術則是典型的側翼迂迴加正面消耗：蔣以津浦線上的山東方向與平漢線上的河北、陝西方向同時施壓，使聯軍南北受敵、首尾不能相顧；正面由蔣鼎文等部沿隴海路穩紮穩打、步步為營，每次攻勢前先用迫擊砲與野砲實施火力準備，再以步兵營連逐次突擊奪取陣地，很少冒險深入；空軍負責偵察、校正砲火與對地轟炸，鐵路與公路上持續把增援部隊、炮彈與糧食運到前線，試圖以調度速度與火力密度壓垮對手。雙方都明白單靠正面強攻代價太高，於是幕後的分化工作與前線的砲火同樣重要：蔣一面對韓復榘等部許以高位，一面派人對聯軍各師策反，而聯軍內部的指揮不統一、補給線互不相通，以及閻馮之間的互相算計，成為其崩潰的內在原因。
tacticsEn: The core of coalition doctrine was to make stand after stand in the depth provided by the Longhai railway and the plains of eastern Henan. Yan's troops dug trenches, built pillboxes and machine-gun nests on both sides of the line between Lanfeng and Guide, turning every county town, railway station and ferry crossing into a blocking point that the Central Army had to reduce one at a time. Feng's northwestern army sought mobility with cavalry and infantry along the borders of Henan-Shaanxi and Henan-Hubei, looking for a flank and for the weak spots in the Central Army, in particular threatening the communications and the food supply behind Chiang's Longhai front. The coalition headquarters at Zhengzhou aimed to seize Kaifeng and Lanfeng before the Central Army could concentrate, and then to force Chiang to divide his forces with a converging offensive from north and south. Nanjing's method was the classic combination of flanking movement and frontal attrition: pressure was applied at the same time from Shandong along the Tianjin-Pukou line and from Hebei and Shaanxi along the Peking-Hankou line, so that the coalition was caught between two fronts and could not support one with the other. On the frontal line the units of Chiang Ting-wen and others advanced along the Longhai railway in a steady, step-by-step fashion and seldom risked a deep penetration: before each attack the mortars and field guns opened a fire preparation, and the infantry then attacked in successive battalion and company attacks to take each position. The air force provided reconnaissance, gun registration and bombardment, while the railways and roads continuously brought up reinforcements, shells and rations, in an attempt to overwhelm the enemy with the speed of movement and the density of fire. Both sides understood that frontal assault alone cost too much, so political work went forward alongside the guns: Chiang made offers of high rank to Han Fuju and similar figures while emissaries worked on the divisions of the coalition, and the disunity of command in the coalition, the mutual disconnection of its supply lines and the suspicion between Yan and Feng became the internal reason for its collapse.
data: 本戰役自一九三〇年五月起，至同年十一月基本結束，歷時約八個月，是國民政府成立後規模最大的一次內戰，戰線縱貫豫、魯、冀、皖、蘇、陝、鄂、湘、桂諸省，地面主軸是自徐州經鄭州、開封、蘭封、歸德直抵洛陽的隴海鐵路，全線縱貫逾千公里。主要會戰包括：四月陝西潼關一線的衝突，五月聯軍通電後全面開戰，六月的濟南攻城戰與隴海線的爭奪，七月至八月的鄭州、開封、蘭封一帶拉鋸與亳州攻守，九月以後豫東歸德方向的突破，至十月鄭州、開封方向的聯軍陣地相繼崩潰、十一月戰局底定。兵力方面各家統計差異極大，常見的說法是中央軍投入兵力在四十萬至六十萬之間，閻錫山與馮玉祥聯軍合計約五十萬至七十萬，廣西方面另有一支規模在十萬上下的桂軍參戰，全戰役交戰兵力合計逾百萬；裝備方面，中央軍可用火炮數以千計，聯軍同樣以步兵為主而重火力不足，飛機數量與戰鬥力以中央軍占優。損失方面，普遍認為雙方作戰陣亡與傷重不治者合計在數十萬量級，但因大量部隊係臨時徵集的民團、地方武裝與散兵，統計口徑混亂，各家說法相差頗大，應視為概略範圍。可考的具體戰例有：六月中央軍第二師等部攻取濟南的戰鬥歷時數日；八月至九月亳州被圍數月的攻守；十月聯軍在隴海線正面被突破後的崩潰。至於雷諾FT等戰車在本戰役中的數量與使用紀錄，現存史料記載零散且互相矛盾，難以覈實。
dataEn: The campaign began in May 1930 and was essentially over by November of the same year, roughly eight months in all. It was the largest civil war fought since the National Government was founded; its frontage ran across Henan, Shandong, Hebei, Anhui, Jiangsu, Shaanxi, Hubei, Hunan and Guangxi, while its main axis was the Longhai railway running from Xuzhou through Zhengzhou, Kaifeng, Lanfeng and Guide to Luoyang, a line more than a thousand kilometres long. The principal actions were the clash at Tongguan in Shaanxi in April; the general outbreak after the coalition's cable in May; the assault on Jinan in June and the struggle for the Longhai line; the seesaw around Zhengzhou, Kaifeng and Lanfeng and the fighting over Bozhou between July and August; the breakthrough towards Guide in eastern Henan after September; the collapse of the coalition positions towards Zhengzhou and Kaifeng in October; and the final decision of the war in November. On manpower the accounts differ enormously: the figures most often quoted are four hundred to six hundred thousand men for the Central Army, about five hundred to seven hundred thousand for the combined forces of Yan Xishang and Feng Yuxiang, and a further force of around one hundred thousand Guangxi troops in the south, so that the total committed on both sides exceeded one million men. On equipment the Central Army had thousands of guns available, while the coalition was again infantry-led and short of heavy firepower; in the air the Central Army was superior in numbers and in quality. On losses the general view is that the killed in action and died of wounds on both sides together ran into the hundreds of thousands, but because so many of the troops were hastily recruited militia, local armed bands and stragglers, the counting methods are confused and the various figures differ a good deal; they should be read as rough ranges. Among the better documented episodes are the several days of street and field fighting by which the Second Division and other Central Army units took Jinan in June, the months-long siege and defence of Bozhou between August and September, and the collapse of the coalition after its frontal line on the Longhai railway was broken in October. As for the number of Renault FT and other tanks used in this campaign and the record of their employment, the surviving material is scattered and contradictory and cannot be checked.
cause: 中原大戰的起因，是北伐之後南京政府要把紙面上的統一變成真正的統一。一九二八年東北易幟，張學良宣佈擁護南京，名義上全國歸於一統，但張作霖留下的奉系軍隊、閻錫山的晉軍與馮玉祥的西北軍仍然各據一方，控制著山西、陝甘寧、青魯等地的財源與兵源，實力遠超中央政府。一九二九年蔣在南京召開全國陸軍編遣會議，企圖以統一番號、裁撤冗師的方式削弱地方軍閥，馮玉祥、閻錫山等均持反感，會議未能推行。蔣隨後要馮玉祥出國考察並交出西北軍，馮拒絕並通電抗爭，兩人交惡；蔣又要求閻錫山裁減晉軍並交出山西的稅收與兵源，閻表面應付而實行抵制。導火線是一九三〇年四月的潼關衝突：中央軍在陝西的部隊與楊虎城、張鳳翽的十七路軍在潼關相遇，中央軍失利，消息傳出後聯軍內部主戰派氣焰高漲；五月，閻錫山在太原通電反對南京，馮玉祥的西北軍自陝甘寧向河南移動，聯軍與中央軍在豫東、豫北接戰，中原大戰全面爆發。深層原因則是國民革命軍內部新氣象與舊軍閥利益之間無法調和：中央軍的整編、編遣與新式化訓練，天然意味著地方軍的裁汰；對蔣而言這是建國的最後一步，對閻、馮而言則是生死之戰。
causeEn: The cause of the Central Plains War was that after the Northern Expedition the Nanjing government wanted to turn a nominal unity into a real one. With the substitution of flags in the Northeast in 1928 Zhang Xueliang declared for Nanjing and the country was formally united, but the Fengtian troops left by Zhang Zuolin, Yan's Shanxi army and Feng's northwestern army each still held a corner of the country, controlled the revenues and the manpower of Shanxi, Shaanxi-Gansu-Ningxia and the Qing-Luo regions, and were in raw strength far above the central government. In 1929 Chiang convened the National Army Reduction Conference at Nanjing, hoping to weaken the provincial warlords by standardising unit designations and cutting redundant divisions; Feng Yuxiang, Yan Xishan and others all resented this and the conference achieved nothing. Chiang then required Feng Yuxiang to go abroad for inspection and hand over the northwestern army; Feng refused and cabled his protest, and the two became bitter enemies. Chiang also demanded that Yan Xishan cut the Shanxi army and give up Shaanxi's revenues and manpower; Yan pretended to comply while resisting in practice. The trigger came in April 1930 at Tongguan: the Central Army detachments in Shaanxi met the Seventeenth Route Army of Yang Hucheng and Zhang Fengxi, and the Central Army was worsted; once the news spread, the hawks in the coalition grew bolder. In May Yan Xishan cabled from Taiyuan against Nanjing, Feng's northwestern army moved out of Shaanxi, Gansu and Ningxia towards Henan, the two sides met in eastern and northern Henan, and the Central Plains War opened in earnest. At a deeper level the cause was that the new temper of the National Revolutionary Army and the old interests of the warlords could not be reconciled: the reorganisation, the reduction conference and the modernised training of the Central Army inevitably meant the disbandment of the provincial armies. For Chiang this was the last step in building the state; for Yan and Feng it was a matter of life and death.
impact: 中原大戰的結果，是南京政府把此前十幾年未能解決的問題一次性解決了。蔣在戰後得以名正言順地推行全國整編，一九三一年起陸軍推行師制整頓與縮編，軍閥割據的格局從此被打破，國民政府的法統也獲得實力上的背書；閻錫山於一九三〇年十二月下野、赴海外考察，一九三一年初由中央派員接掌山西，延續二十餘年的「山西王」時代告終；馮玉祥兵敗後隱居泰山，一九三三年曾在察哈爾抗日作戰，此後被蔣調離，一九三五年被押解南京，昔日西北軍的影響力自此一落千丈；韓復榘在山東坐大，成為日後華北的隱患，一九三八年抗戰不力被蔣槍斃；李宗仁、白崇禧退回廣西，反而保留了完整建制，成為桂系日後的根據地；張學良的東北軍入關，奉系勢力從此被蔣有步驟地收編。全局來看，這場戰爭也讓蔣付出代價：中央軍主力被牽制在中原與江西兩個方向，「剿共」作戰只能暫時收縮，紅軍趁一九三〇至三一年的空檔在湘鄂贛一帶擴張，蘇維埃根據地的面積成倍增加。此後十餘年，日本在華北步步進逼，中原大戰的勝負最終證明了這一點：控制鐵路樞紐、掌握空軍與政治分化，仍然比坦克與重砲更決定戰局；軍閥時代的部隊在鐵路與汽車的調度速度面前，暴露出編制落後、補給脆弱、指揮割裂的致命弱點，而這一課在全面抗戰爆發後被再次驗證。
impactEn: The outcome of the Central Plains War was that the Nanjing government settled in a single stroke the problems it had been unable to solve for more than a decade. After the victory Chiang could push through a reorganisation of the whole army under the banner of unification; from 1931 the army was reorganised and its divisions reduced, the pattern of warlord separatism was broken, and the legal standing of the National Government gained a backing in actual power. Yan Xishan resigned in December 1930 and went abroad, and in early 1931 central officials took over Shanxi, ending the more than twenty-year era of the Shanxi king. Feng Yuxiang retired to Mount Tai after his defeat, fought in Chahar in 1933, was then moved away by Chiang and in 1935 was taken to Nanjing under guard, and the influence of the old northwestern army fell to nothing. Han Fuju grew powerful in Shandong and became a hidden danger in North China until Chiang had him shot in 1938 for his conduct in the war against Japan. Li Zongren and Bai Chongxi fell back into Guangxi but kept their formations intact, which became the base of the Guangxi clique for years to come; Zhang Xueliang's Northeastern Army entered the passes, and the Fengtian forces were thereafter absorbed step by step by Chiang. Taken as a whole, the war also cost Chiang dear: the main body of the Central Army was tied down in two theatres, in the central plains and in Jiangxi, the campaigns against the communists had to be suspended, and the Red Army used the lull of 1930 and 1931 to expand across Hunan, Hubei and Jiangxi, multiplying the area of the soviet base areas. In the years that followed Japan advanced step by step in North China, and the verdict of the Central Plains War was confirmed: control of the railway junctions, command of the air and political division of the enemy still decided campaigns more than tanks and heavy guns did. The troops of the warlord era, measured against the speed of movement offered by rail and road, exposed a fatal weakness in outdated organisation, fragile supply and divided command — a lesson that was verified once more when full-scale resistance began.
result: 到一九三〇年十月，聯軍在隴海線正面的防線被突破，鄭州、開封方向的陣地相繼崩潰，馮玉祥的部隊在豫中被擊散，多數各奔東西；十一月戰局底定，閻錫山通電下野，馮玉祥退往山東、藏身青島，張學良的東北軍在天津與蔣達成協議後入關，控制平津，聯軍失去最後的戰略支點。蔣以中央軍佔領鄭州、開封、濟南，並控制隴海、平漢、津浦三線的態勢宣布戰事結束，中央政府的軍令與政令自此可以在河南、山東、河北、陝西一線通行；但聯軍並非全滅，閻錫山保住了山西，馮玉祥的西北軍一部西撤回寧夏、甘肅，殘部後來被蔣分別改編收編，聯軍的失敗最終以改頭換面的方式被吸收進中央軍的序列。戰後蔣以此役為由推進全國軍隊的整編與統一編制，晉系與西北系的將領多被調離原職、改任閒職或出國考察，地方軍的番號陸續撤銷，中央軍的編制與德械整訓成為全軍標準，國民政府的軍事獨裁也隨之鞏固。就這場戰爭本身而言，勝者是蔣介石的南京政府，敗者是閻、馮的軍閥聯盟；而卡面那輛雷諾FT所代表的機械化力量，在豫東那種以鐵路與平原為舞臺的戰爭裡始終沒能翻盤，它說明的是一個時代，而不是一場戰局。
resultEn: By October 1930 the coalition's frontal line on the Longhai railway had been broken, its positions towards Zhengzhou and Kaifeng collapsed in turn, and Feng Yuxiang's troops were scattered in eastern Henan, most of them going their own ways. In November the decision was made: Yan Xishan cabled his resignation, Feng Yuxiang fell back to Shandong and hid on the coast at Qingdao, and after Zhang Xueliang reached an agreement with Chiang at Tianjin the Northeastern Army entered the passes and took control of Peking and Tientsin, and the coalition lost its last strategic support. With the Central Army in possession of Zhengzhou, Kaifeng and Jinan and of the Longhai, Peking-Hankou and Tianjin-Pukou lines, Chiang declared the fighting at an end, and the orders of the central government could henceforth reach Henan, Shandong, Hebei and Shaanxi. The coalition was not annihilated, however: Yan Xishan kept Shanxi, part of Feng's northwestern army withdrew west into Ningxia and Gansu, and the remnants were later absorbed and reorganised by Chiang, so that the defeat of the coalition was in the end taken into the Central Army's order of battle in a new guise. After the war Chiang used it to carry through the reorganisation and the standardisation of formations across the country; Shanxi and northwestern commanders were moved from their posts, given sinecure appointments or sent abroad, the designations of the provincial armies were cancelled one after another, the organisation and German-style training of the Central Army became the standard for the whole army, and the military dictatorship of the National Government was thereby consolidated. As for the war itself, the winner was Chiang Kai-shek's Nanjing government and the loser was the coalition of Yan and Feng; and the mechanised force represented by the Renault FT on the card was never able to overturn a war fought on the plains of eastern Henan around railways and roads. What it illustrates is an age, not a battle.
